name: deployment-config-runtime
goal: Runtime dependencies resolve in bundled Node and external preview execution

evidence: PR 15 introduced a deep JSONC ESM import that Node cannot resolve; the managed web preview returns 500 with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for impl/format.
The existing deployment-config boundary test bundles every dependency, hiding external package entry resolution. Extend its matrix to both bundled and external JSONC under Node.

775ea77b reproduces the actual impl/format resolution failure with the installed package found; bundled mode passes and external mode fails under Node. Earlier 3ae3496c had an incorrect NODE_PATH and is setup failure, not defect proof.
Use the supported public JSONC entry. Keep the existing boundary test matrix in normal verification and require bundled plus external execution when server code is shared with the preview.
b77e749f uses the public package entry for Node; 82a8e5d9 resolves only JSONC to its ESM entry during desktop bundling. The boundary matrix uses actual shared build options.
82a8e5d9 passes the same unchanged boundary matrix recorded failing at acd89b73, in the same environment. Both bundled and external Node modes parse JSONC successfully.

An isolated snapshot of 82a8e5d9 fails the unchanged four-case matrix when the original private ESM import is reintroduced (impl/format), then passes all four cases after restoring the public entry. Logs preserved outside Git.
